newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC Pacific to buy CLP stake.
newsitem.headline: CITIC Pacific to buy CLP stake.

text.p: Hong Kong's CITIC Pacific Ltd said on Tuesday it would acquire 497,664,000 new shares in China Light & Power Co Ltd (CLP) at HK$32.66 each, representing a 20 percent stake in CLP's enlarged share capital.
The issue price represents a discount of about 3.1 percent to CLP's closing price of HK$33.70 per share on Monday.
Trading in both companies was suspended on Tuesday.

CITIC Pacific said the placement would be divided into two tranches. The first comprises 199,065,600 new shares representing 10 percent of CLP's existing share capital and is pursuent to the mandate granted to CLP directors.
The second tranche comprises 298,598,400 new shares and represents 15 percent of the existing share capital of CLP and is dependent on CLP shareholders' approval.
CITIC said the holding is a long-term investment and undertook not to dispose of any of the new CLP shares for at least three years.
CITIC has applied for a resumption in trading of its shares from Wednesday.
CLP was not immediately available for comment.
